name: Community Workshop Coordinator
text: Schedule community workshops and keep attendance records. A bachelor's degree is preferred, not required. Applicants may qualify with two years of workshop coordination experience instead of a degree. Keep participant contact details confidential.

name: Records Technician I and II
text: Both levels maintain the records inventory and protect confidential records. Records Technician I: No college degree is required. One year of records support experience is required. Records Technician II: A bachelor's degree in information management is required. Three years of records management experience is required. Level II also supervises the records team.

name: Archive Assistant
text: Label archive boxes, record shelf locations, and help visitors locate public documents. The source description does not state education, experience, or professional license requirements.
